name: agda-native-ide
description: A workbench beside agda-mode-vscode for the active Agda module.

commands.title: Show Goal and Context in Agda Mode
Write a Starter flake.nix for the Project

agdaWorkbench.agda.path.description: The agda the native lanes run, by a path or a name on PATH; when set, it wins over agda-for-project.  Empty: the project's own Agda, through agda-for-project when it is configured (agdaWorkbench.launcher.path, or the last of agdaMode.connection.paths), else the last of agda-mode-vscode's agdaMode.connection.paths that names an agda (not a language server), else agda on PATH.

agdaWorkbench.agda.commandLineOptions.description: The options of the agda that agdaWorkbench.agda.path names, delimited by spaces.  Without that path, the native lanes take agdaMode.connection.commandLineOptions, as agda-mode-vscode's own agda does.

agdaWorkbench.agda.version.description: The Agda version the native lanes must run, when set; they refuse an agda that answers --numeric-version with another.  Empty: the version of the project's own Agda (through agda-for-project), or 2.9.0 without it.  The lanes speak Agda 2.9.0 and 2.8.0.

agdaWorkbench.launcher.path.description: agda-for-project, by a path or a name on PATH, for the native lanes and the status item.  Empty: the last of agdaMode.connection.paths, when it names agda-for-project.

agdaWorkbench.mode.steer.description: When agda-mode-vscode runs agda-for-project (the last of agdaMode.connection.paths), point it at the active file's project (AGDA_FOR_PROJECT_DIR in the extension host) and restart it when that project needs another Agda.

agdaWorkbench.lanes.idleMinutes.description: How long a project's native lane may sit idle before it is closed.
